notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Deathbringer Thoctar lifelink.
Deathbringer Thoctar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Give Deathbringer Thoctar lifelink, if needed.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.
